1 Introduction

The author made tools to calculate the quantum invariant of knots and links obtained
from sl3 by using the Kuperberg’s linear skein theory. In this article, we will introduce
one of these tools, a full twist formula, which is useful to compute explicitly the lz colored
Jones polynomial. As an application, we give explicit formula of the one-row colored sl3
tail for a (2, 2m)-torus link.
